theme: Skia m151 and managed math ports
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia milestone m151 and ports more color math to managed C# for performance.
highlights_body: It fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, ports SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions off native calls, speeds up HarfBuzzSharp buffer and tag parsing, and adds new WASM/Emscripten test coverage.

bullets.detail: Bundles Chrome milestone m151 along with several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges, and drops a workaround for SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.
Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI).
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression introduced upstream.

bullets.lead: More math ported to managed C#
bullets.detail: Moves SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply to managed integer math, removing per-call native round-trips.

Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) pooled and allocation-free, removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans, and speeds up SKColor hex parsing with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads.
Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11, builds emsdk 5.0.6 libs with the new exnref exception handling, and adds a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the Skia submodule, fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak, and sped up HarfBuzzSharp buffer handling

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 stabilized the m151 engine bump and the managed math ports ahead of the stable release.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 landed the HarfBuzzSharp performance work and further chrome/m151 bug-fix merges.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with the Skia milestone m151 update and the SKColorF/SKPMColor managed math ports.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding, removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, and adds WASM/Emscripten 5.0.6 static library support.
